changesFromV1: Only the policy observation helper checks existing currentRoute() for after:, cron:, and workflow: prefixes before using the active batch map.

Real afterJob retains the scheduling ALS snapshot and executes while the parent batch remains active in the regression. Repeated jobs read each current policy, foreground siblings retain their original request-local observation.
Actual cronJob and workflow runJob are checked against false/true observations without changing scheduler behavior.
unchanged: Original SQL text, parameters, false/absent-row/error semantics, all credential data and authorization consumers
Effective database executor plus exact workspace identity
Batch lifetime invalidation and per-request map isolation
Background scheduling, timing, database requests, invocation order and query windows
Original Native/Web totals, no background subtraction
contextBoundary: The existing global route scope exposes the innermost route. Standard afterJob/cronJob/runJob install their labelled context. This change excludes those existing labelled scopes; it does not create a new general scheduler or replace route context semantics.
noCycle: read-batch-context imports tracing/labels, which imports only node:async_hooks; it does not import jobs/background or OpenTelemetry.
